import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, A, n):
        A = np.asarray(A, dtype=np.float64)
        assert A.shape == (n, n)
        assert np.ndim(n) == 0
        # a = A_1,1
        self.a = A[1-1, 1-1]
